bio: Cecilia Valier has transformed from a simple facchino to a woman of modest but growing means in her mid-40s. Her journey from the docks to the printing house is etched in the fine lines around her honey-colored eyes, which now scrutinize manuscripts with the same attentiveness once reserved for merchant cargoes.
